body:
## Problem
In `delivery.release_view` and `delivery.notes_view` (`solace-cli/delivery/src/delivery.gleam`):

- **Ask for notes** has no busy state. `AskNotes` posts and clears the error. Nothing on the page says notes are being written until a `releaseNotes` event arrives, and the button can be pressed again and again.
- **Reject** (`RejectNotes`) immediately posts `/notes/reject`. That throws away the draft and any edits the human typed into the textarea (`notes_edit`), with no confirmation. One misclick loses the work. The page already confirms other destructive acts in-app (D-32, D-259 point 6).
- The notes `textarea` has no label, so screen readers announce an unnamed text box.

## Change
1. Add `asking_notes: Bool` to `Model`:
   - Set it on `AskNotes`.
   - Clear it on `NotesAsked` error or when the release's notes arrive.
   - Disable the button and label it "Asking…" while set.
   - While a draft is being written, show "Writing release notes…" in the notes section.
2. Reject: when `edited_notes(model)` differs from the stored draft (or always), first show Solace's in-app prompt via `solace_task.modal`: "Reject these notes? Your edits will be lost." with **Reject** and **Keep editing**. Post only on confirm.
3. Give the textarea `aria-label="Release notes"`.

## Check
Add tests in `solace-cli/delivery/test/delivery_test.gleam`:
- `update(model, AskNotes(v))` sets the busy flag and the view shows a disabled "Asking…" button.
- `RejectNotes` with edited notes opens the confirmation and sends nothing until it is confirmed.

Run the delivery project's tests.
title: Release notes: show progress and confirm Reject
